name: Newpark Mall
summary: Large mall with plentiful shopping, a food court, play areas for kids & a Sunday farmer's market.
demographics: NewPark Mall serves the diverse and growing East Bay community of Newark and surrounding areas, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals from the thriving Silicon Valley region. The trade area encompasses a multicultural demographic with significant Asian and Hispanic populations, along with tech industry workers who value convenience and variety in their shopping experience. Visitors typically seek a mix of value and quality, gravitating toward mainstream retailers, diverse dining options, and family-friendly entertainment that reflects the area's demographic diversity and suburban lifestyle preferences.
description: NewPark Mall is a premier 1.1-million-square-foot enclosed regional shopping destination located in Newark, California, serving the diverse East Bay community. The mall recently completed a multimillion-dollar renovation specifically designed to cater to the evolving needs of its customer base and cement its position as the East Bay's leading entertainment, dining, and shopping destination. With its strategic location and comprehensive mix of stores and restaurants, NewPark Mall offers visitors a complete shopping experience under one roof. The center is managed by Brookfield Properties, a globally recognized real estate company known for operating high-quality retail destinations. Whether you're looking for the latest fashion trends, enjoying a meal at one of the many restaurants, or simply spending quality time with family, NewPark Mall provides a comfortable and convenient environment with extended holiday hours and special discounts for students, educators, military personnel, and first responders.
